# Abdul Aziz, Portfolio

> AI & Automation Solutions Architect based in Sydney, Australia. AI agents, data pipelines, Shopify & commerce systems. Portfolio and selected work; collaborations and engineering conversations welcome.

Abdul Aziz designs and builds AI automation infrastructure that powers business operations. Focus: AI agents, data pipelines, commerce automation, and end-to-end workflow automation. Tech: Python, Azure, FiveTran, Hevo, Hex, Shopify, React, Node, Laravel. Work spans eCommerce and retail, fintech, business operations, and professional services.

- **Title:** AI & Automation Solutions Architect
- **Location:** Sydney, NSW, Australia
- **Experience:** 5+ years; 30+ projects delivered
- **Education:** Master of ICT (Griffith University / Canterbury Institute of Management); BSc IT (Arid Agriculture University)
- **Contact:** hello@abdulaziz.au | +61 451 556 175

This site is a static portfolio (not job-seeking). Content is in YAML; rendered client-side with vanilla JS (ES modules). Sections: hero, profile snapshot, about, how I work, experience, skills, projects, education, FAQ, contact.
